TypeParameters.Name: Description
TypeParameters.Value: Check valves permit flow in one direction only, and close automatically if flow reverses. They are entirely automatic in action, depending upon pressure and velocity of flow within the line to perform their functions of opening and closing. Swing pattern metal faced disc.

TypeParameters.Name: Specification Notes
TypeParameters.Value: Valves are manufactured in accordance with BS EN 12334: 2001. End flanges conform to BS EN 1092-2 with raised face and are normally supplied drilled. This valve is not suitable for use on group 1 gases or unstable fluids as defined by the Pressure Equipment Directive 97/23/EC.
